# Venn Intelligence Foundation

> Venn Intelligence Foundation is a research foundation that funds and runs
> frontier AI research. Three projects: autonomous driving (sponsor and
> competing team in the NVIDIA AlpaSim E2E Closed-Loop Challenge 2026),
> Project Σ (decentralized collective intelligence protocol) and Project Ω
> (AI-native trading system with full development transparency).
> Founded by Taitan Pascal. Based at vennai.org.

## About
- [Homepage](https://vennai.org/): Landing page with full project overviews
- [Autonomous Driving](https://vennai.org/drive): AlpaSim E2E Closed-Loop Challenge 2026 project page
- [Blog](https://vennai.org/blog): Thoughts and announcements

## Autonomous Driving — NVIDIA AlpaSim E2E Closed-Loop Challenge 2026
- Role: the foundation sponsors and fields a competing team
- Organisers: NVIDIA Autonomous Vehicle Research Group, KE:SAI, OpenDriveLab (HKU); results shared at NeurIPS 2026
- Closed loop first: every candidate drives full-length simulated scenes before a number is believed
- Collision forensics: each at-fault contact is traced back to the decision that planned it
- Pre-registered reads: pass lines fixed before a run; misses are kept and labelled
- Self-consequence labels: training rows built from what the policy caused in its own rollouts
- Method names, scores and leaderboard entries are withheld until the challenge closes

## Project Σ — Collective Intelligence Protocol
- Proof of Humanity: Zero-knowledge proof of unique personhood — without revealing identity
- The Σ Engine: Information-theoretic evaluation of every message's true contribution to collective intelligence
- Cognitive Topology: Multi-dimensional cognitive space where content flows from high to low potential
- Bazaar of Currencies: Fork your own tribe, issue your own token — wisdom priced by the free market

## Project Ω — AI-Native Trading Infrastructure
- Agent-Native Intelligence: LLM as primary decision maker, not a plugin
- Trigger-Driven Precision: Agent-generated conditional hooks that fire on exact market signals
- Reflection Dashboard: Transparent trade outcome and performance tracking
- Human-Agent Co-governance: Real-time Telegram integration for manual orders, status queries, and danger alerts
